title: Cuspidal Singularities in Collapsing Domain Walls
summary: Domain wall networks have attracted renewed interest, particularly in relation to the dynamics of network collapse. Accurately describing this process is challenging and typically requires large scale numerical simulations. Here we adopt a complementary approach by studying the collapse of individual closed domain walls, extending previous thin wall analyses and comparing them with adaptive mesh refinement field theory simulations.
